**Finding submitted — AUDIT: deviation (fallback cure proposed).**

- **Responsive clause:** § 11.3 Suspected Violations (p0132) is the document's only verification right against Customer; targeted searches for *audit, inspection, verification, records, monitor, usage* found no other audit mechanic, and §§ 11.5, 12.1, 13.2 contain none.
- **Why it fails fallback:** IBM's right to investigate AUP compliance is unbounded — no frequency cap, no notice of the investigation (the p0137 notice attaches only to access restriction/Content removal remedies), and no cost allocation; p0138 compels Customer to supply all relevant information on request. Unlimited/unannounced verification is walk-away territory.
- **Cure (fallback, one insertion after p0137):** one investigation per year, at least 15 days' notice, IBM bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%.
- Preferred-only items (independent auditor, confidentiality, off-site, 5% threshold, no system access) were deliberately not added, since the selected level is the fallback and the clause grants no direct system access.
